scope: Keep the original risk experiment and both GPU Train producers unchanged. Finish its registered fitting and complete-Dev decision. These are follow-up hypotheses, not a running method, accepted contribution or accuracy result.

priority_1.hypothesis: A Train-calibrated reliability decision can selectively revise a confidently wrong geometric assignment, instead of protecting it unconditionally.
priority_1.evidence: On the unchanged original Dev trajectory, hard geometric protection masks17 desired diagnostic edges, including13 short-gap and3 continuous events. This does not prove a proposed override would select a correct match.
priority_1.planned_mechanism: Permit a risk-model mutual preference to override a protected row/column only under a threshold frozen on late Train wrong-edge scores and an explicit uniqueness margin. Retain all protected matches otherwise; no GT/event/time routing at inference.
priority_1.intended_calibration: Evaluate the stricter99.9th percentile wrong-edge threshold with probability margin0.05, before complete-Dev replay; formally register the implemented policy and engineering evidence first.
priority_1.controls: Same fitted coefficients, same detector/encoders, RGB-masked versus paired identity features; original static protection remains a complete-Dev control. Fixed seed0.

priority_2.hypothesis: Train-supervised archive-to-new-tracklet reasoning can preserve identity after the active25-frame pool has expired.
priority_2.evidence: 26 of30 long-gap native-Dev diagnostic events have the previous identity outside the primary pool. Existing fixed RGB late linking reduces only3 of these long-gap event counts.
priority_2.planned_mechanism: Learn a separately calibrated archive decision from actual Train old-template/new-tracklet pairs on the unchanged teacher trajectory. Keep tracker lifetime and emitted prefixes causal. Retire only after true matching-pool departure; never use future features or GT identities at inference.
priority_2.fit_requirement: Use all6 complete Train candidate banks and all27251 frames after successful closure. Current short-gap model scores are not assumed calibrated for archive gaps; archive coefficients and thresholds need separate Train supervision and calibration.
priority_2.controls: Existing fixed RGB late links, RGB-masked archive model, paired archive model, and no archive decision; complete-Dev selection before any new Test. No extra seeds or image/FPN copies.
